mapper.sql: CAST(b.id AS CHAR) AS id,b.name,b.description,b.icon,b.color,b.sort_no AS sortNo,b.rule_type AS ruleType,b.threshold,b.status, CAST(b.created_by AS CHAR) AS createdBy,DATE_FORMAT(b.published_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS publishedAt, DATE_FORMAT(b.created_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt,DATE_FORMAT(b.updated_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updatedAt
mapper.select: SELECT ,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forum_member_badge mb WHERE mb.badge_id=b.id) AS awardedCount FROM forum_badge b WHERE b.status=#{status} ORDER BY b.sort_no,b.id
SELECT FROM forum_badge b WHERE b.id=#{id}
SELECT FROM forum_badge b WHERE b.id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM forum_badge b WHERE b.status='PUBLISHED' ORDER BY b.sort_no,b.id
mapper.update: UPDATE forum_badge SET name=#{name},description=#{description},icon=#{icon},color=#{color},sort_no=#{sortNo}, rule_type=#{ruleType},threshold=#{threshold} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='DRAFT'
UPDATE forum_badge SET status='PUBLISHED',published_at=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND status='DRAFT'
UPDATE forum_badge SET status='OFFLINE' WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PUBLISHED'
mapper.select: SELECT account_id AS accountId FROM forum_member ORDER BY account_id

SELECT ,DATE_FORMAT(mb.awarded_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS awardedAt, CAST(mb.id AS CHAR) AS memberBadgeId FROM forum_badge b LEFT JOIN forum_member_badge mb ON mb.badge_id=b.id AND mb.account_id=#{accountId} WHERE b.status='PUBLISHED' OR mb.id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY b.sort_no,b.id
SELECT 100+COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN change_points>0 THEN change_points ELSE 0 END),0) FROM forum_point_log WHERE account_id=#{accountId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forum_thread WHERE author_account_id=#{accountId} AND deleted=0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forum_comment WHERE author_account_id=#{accountId} AND deleted=0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forum_checkin WHERE account_id=#{accountId}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(likes_count),0) FROM forum_thread WHERE author_account_id=#{accountId} AND deleted=0
